newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Lech Brewer no longer publicly traded.
newsitem.headline: Polish Lech Brewer no longer publicly traded.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) withdrew Polish brewer Lech Browary Wielkopolski SA (Lech) shares from trade on Thursday, KPW said in a statement.
In June, Lech asked the commission to remove it from the list of publicly traded firms seeking bourse entry as it no longer needed outside capital.
Lech said it expected to record sales of about 350 million zlotys this year against 250 million zlotys last year.
